svg.aria-label: How Ember answers: you ask, memory and prompt, the model decides, it searches the docs or uses the page in your browser, a grounding check, and the answer
svg.text: Postgres history, a summary when it
gets long, and the reply language
on the server, then back to ③
Every number must come from the page,
a tool or the docs, or it is rewritten
You ask: “Is March unusual in Santiago?” The page adds what you are looking at.
The server loads the conversation from Postgres and builds the prompt.
The model decides what to do next (at most 8 steps per message).
It searches the project documents for how the harmonization works.
The model decides what to do next (at most 8 steps per message).
It selects the area and the month in your browser, with a visible cursor.
The model decides what to do next (at most 8 steps per message).
Before replying, every figure is checked against the page, the tools and the docs.
You get a short answer in your language. The model key never reaches the browser.
